An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
A holder can request An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
A holder can request A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
A holder can request Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.

A holder can request A bank-issued attestation of the securities holding voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, Revealing the name and identity of the ultimate beneficial investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Registering the voting holder before instructions can be accepted is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
For the current ballot, An executed power of attorney supplied by the ultimate investor is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Voting instructions must reach the custodian by 26 November 2026 at 16:00 UTC.
Immobilising the positions earmarked for the ballot until the meeting closes is compulsory; the ballot cannot be submitted unless that condition is satisfied.
A holder can request Bringing loaned securities back into custody before voting voluntarily; this remains optional and does not determine voting eligibility.
For the current ballot, A rule forbidding different voting choices within the same holding is not a condition and is expressly unnecessary.
Operations still needs clarification as to whether An eligibility rule excluding retail investors from the ballot is a voting condition.
